objective: Fix both PR 354 CI failures by restoring the validated CUDA 12.8.1 immutable base after synchronizing main, and guard consistency with image metadata and the GPU matrix.
acceptance: The existing two container assertions fail before the fix and pass after it.
FROM, OCI base labels, build inventory and GPU matrix describe the same CUDA baseline and immutable digest.
Required repository tests, contracts, scenarios and context checks pass on the synchronized branch.
No control behavior, contract, vulnerability gate or test threshold is weakened.
evidence: Before/after container test output in the project Docker image
Required-check output and PR 354 CI checks
Existing M1 runtime evidence in docs/evaluation/motion-m1-smoothness.md remains evidence for CUDA 12.8.1 only
risks_and_fallbacks: CUDA 13 adoption is deferred until image metadata, host driver requirements and GPU simulation are validated together; restoring the existing baseline does not establish CUDA 13 compatibility.
Dependabot can propose a future baseline change; the baseline and consistency tests must remain blocking.
stop_conditions: A control, firmware or public contract change is required.
The validated CUDA 12.8.1 base cannot build or fails the existing supply-chain gate.
